sample.description: Pooled CPI-day panel of ~100 large-cap US equities balanced across 11 SPDR sectors (SPY market log return; ΔVIX daily change; ΔDGS10 daily change from FRED; DXY log return; sector ETF log return). CPI release dates 2015-2025 from BLS. Pooled OLS on CPI dates, SE clustered by date.
sample.substitutions: Ticker identities proxied: 99 defined (9×11), 98 retained (EA no Yahoo data). Market SPY adj_close log return; VIX Δ = ^VIX close diff; DGS10 Δ from FRED fredgraph.csv ffill to trading days then diff; DXY log return from DX-Y.NYB; sector ETF adj_close log return (XLRE from 2015-10-08, XLC from 2018-06-19 cause early drops, counted as 409 sector-missing obs). CPI dates scraped from bls.gov/bls/news-release/cpi.htm (cpi_MMDDYYYY.htm) with fallback hard-coded; 2 Good Fridays dropped. SE clustered by date (paper prints none). FRED and market data vintages live 2025-10-10. No leave-one-out index built per paper.

notes: Every choice paper leaves open and deviations: (1) Tickers: paper ~100 large-cap balanced across 11 SPDR sectors, no list; built 9 per sector =99 (XLF/XLE/XLK/XLV/XLI/XLB/XLP/XLY/XLU/XLRE/XLC), 98 retained (EA has no Yahoo prices in this window). Standard large-cap names; any similar set is same design. (2) Market proxy: SPY log return; used adj_close log return (dividend/split adjusted) as standard; paper says log return. (3) VIX proxy: ^VIX close daily point change (paper ΔVIX daily change); Yahoo ^VIX is CBOE VIX. (4) DGS10 proxy: FRED DGS10 via fredgraph.csv; paper ΔDGS10 daily change. Levels forward-filled to trading days then first-differenced (handles FRED blanks on holidays). Alternative using 10y yield ETF ^TNX gives similar. (5) DXY proxy: DX-Y.NYB (Yahoo ICE Dollar Index) log return; paper DXY log return. UUP would be alternative. (6) Sector ETFs: 11 SPDRs XLF/XLE/XLK/XLV/XLI/XLB/XLP/XLY/XLU/XLRE/XLC; paper SPDR sector ETF return. XLC inception 2018-06-19 and XLRE 2015-10-08 mean early CPI dates drop those sector tickers when sector required (dropped_sector counted). (7) CPI shock days: BLS archive index cpi.htm links cpi_MMDDYYYY.htm parsed with Mozilla UA; fallback hard-coded list verifies 131 dates 2015-2025 (paper 2015-2025). 2 Good Fridays (2017-04-14, 2020-04-10) are non-trading and dropped; no shift to next trading day. Mapping to SPY trading index. (8) Returns alignment: all log returns adj_close except VIX point change and DGS10 point change, aligned on same trading day T (contemporaneous). (9) Estimation: pooled OLS with intercept; SE reported as cluster-robust by date (cross-sectional dependence). Paper prints no SE/t/p for Fig3a; we supply cluster SE. HC0 SE also computed but cluster is appropriate. (10) Results: uncontrolled 0.909 (se 0.043) vs paper ~0.9; controlled with sector -0.030 (se 0.019) vs paper ~0.03. Both near zero, order-of-magnitude collapse; sign around zero is noise when residual market beta is near zero and SE 0.02 straddles zero. Without sector 0.83 (se 0.05) vs paper 'materially attenuated but positive' (no numeric) – consistent. (11) Period: live Yahoo ends 2025-10-10 vs paper 2015-2025 inclusive; FRED DGS10 up to 2025-12-31 but truncated to market window. Difference noted in sample. (12) Other pillars (environment dependence Fig3b-e, residual loadings Fig3f, lag profile Fig4) not in headline spec; our lag check shows c0 large ~0.91 without sector and ~0.0 with sector due to collinearity – paper's pillar2 c0 large is consistent with specification without sector control, we detail in subs. (13) Aggregator Contradiction proposition is analytical; not estimated. Live vintage and ticker-proxy are substitutions per SCORE, not sample differences; missing/extra are 0 because no paper N was printed to differ from.
